Market today: The 10-year Treasury yield jumping to a 19-year high is the main driver, signaling higher rates which typically pressure growth and tech stocks. Your concentrated tech/chip book, especially on margin, feels this pressure acutely.
Your holdings: SOXL (-37.3%) and SPAL (-30.22%) are flagged for attention. These leveraged ETFs are bleeding and decay is a constant enemy, amplified by margin.
Watch: Keep an eye on the Treasury yields and any follow-through in semiconductor names.
Bottom line: Focus on managing your leveraged positions and the rising rate environment.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming or exiting this leveraged position given the significant loss and decay risk.
SPAL: Similar to SOXL, evaluate reducing exposure due to the large loss and inherent decay.
MUU: The scanner shows a BUY setup (entry 37.26-37.23, stop 36.97). Given it's already a holding, consider if this setup confirms a reason to add or hold.
